current_monthly: employment / own observed November2022 employment * 100; missing or nonpositive baseline gives null
annual: No November observation. Annual index is null and not offered as current chart view.
archived_res: res.json, gender-totals.json and res-employment-indices.csv retain historical 2022 April/October mean indices. Their graphs are hidden and exports labeled archive.
standardized: Common pooled-sex November2022 occupation weights applied to within-occupation sex-specific growth ratios; not an observed headcount index.
